title: cadintent submission
description: An ordered group of commands handed to the kernel together, applied atomically — all land or none do. Carries the declared head and a mandatory scope declaration. Spec version 0.1.0.

SubmittedCommand.description: One command as authored, before acceptance. The kernel stamps seq, batch, and created_at at acceptance to complete the nine-field envelope.

payload.description: The kind-specific payload, validated against the schema the kind declares.

project.description: The project whose log this submission targets.

head.description: The head seq this submission was decided against (0 for an empty log). A stale head refuses the whole submission — no blind append.

commands.description: The ordered commands. Later commands may reference ULIDs minted earlier in the same submission.
